text.tspan: Total COVID-19 tests per 1,000 vs. GDP per capita Jun 22, 2022
Comparisons across countries are affected by differences in testing policies and reporting methods. GDP per
capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita in 2020 (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Cumulative total per 1,000 people (plotted on a logarithmic axis)
